def process():
    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    a.sort()
    i = -1
    j = 0
    t = int(input())
    max_count = 0
    while j != n:
        i += 1
        while j < n and a[j] - a[i] <= t:
            j += 1
        max_count = max(max_count, j - i)
    print(max_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    process()
